mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.object_id, f.object_value, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, f.attested_to, f.end_derived, f.attested_from AS dated_at, f.valid_from_grade, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = ts.statement_id JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE ts.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described')) AS described FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.subject_id = #{holder} AND f.predicate_id = #{predicateId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.recorded_at FOR UPDATE OF f

SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.object_id, f.object_value, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, f.attested_to, f.end_derived, f.attested_from AS dated_at, f.valid_from_grade, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = ts.statement_id JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE ts.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described')) AS described FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.object_id = #{holder} AND f.predicate_id = #{predicateId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.recorded_at FOR UPDATE OF f

SELECT DISTINCT f.subject_id, f.object_id, f.predicate_id, r.functional, r.inverse_functional FROM facts f JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.id = ANY(#{factIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AND r.temporal = 'state' AND (r.functional OR r.inverse_functional)
SELECT functional AND inverse_functional FROM relation_types WHERE id = #{predicateId}
SELECT functional, inverse_functional, temporal FROM relation_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND id = #{predicateId}
SELECT id FROM facts WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND predicate_id = #{predicateId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND (object_id IS NOT NULL OR object_value IS NOT NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE id = #{factId} AND kb_id = #{kbId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT end_derived FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT valid_from, predicate_id FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL AND (NOT #{requireOpen} OR (valid_to IS NULL AND valid_to_precision IS NULL)) FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, object_value, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_from_grade, valid_to, valid_to_precision, confidence, supersedes, attested_from, attested_by, attested_to, end_derived, from_statement_id, implied, corrected_ends) SELECT #{corrected}, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, object_value, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_from_grade, #{validTo}, #{precision}, confidence, id, attested_from, attested_by, CASE WHEN #{precision}::text = 'unknown' THEN COALESCE(#{anchor}, now()) END, #{derived}, from_statement_id, implied,
CASE corrected_ends WHEN 'both' THEN 'start' WHEN 'end' THEN NULL ELSE corrected_ends END FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, object_value, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_to, valid_to_precision, confidence, derived_by_rule, supersedes, attested_from, attested_to, end_derived, from_statement_id, implied, corrected_ends) SELECT #{moved}, kb_id, COALESCE(#{subjectId}, subject_id), predicate_id, COALESCE(#{objectId}, object_id), object_value, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_to, valid_to_precision, confidence, derived_by_rule, id, attested_from, attested_to, end_derived, from_statement_id, implied, corrected_ends FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}
mapper.update: UPDATE facts SET invalidated_at = now() WHERE id = #{factId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_evidence (fact_id, chunk_id, quote, proposed_predicate, document_id, doc_version, quote_start, quote_end) SELECT #{to}, chunk_id, quote, proposed_predicate, document_id, doc_version, quote_start, quote_end FROM fact_evidence WHERE fact_id = #{from} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO fact_qualifiers (fact_id, qualifier_type_id, value, entity_id) SELECT #{to}, qualifier_type_id, value, entity_id FROM fact_qualifiers WHERE fact_id = #{from} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT temporal FROM relation_types WHERE id = #{predicateId}
SELECT predicate_id FROM facts WHERE id = #{factId}

INSERT INTO facts (id, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, object_value, valid_from, valid_from_precision, valid_to, valid_to_precision, confidence, supersedes, attested_from, attested_to, from_statement_id, implied, corrected_ends) SELECT #{corrected}, kb_id, subject_id, predicate_id, object_id, object_value, #{from}, #{fromPrecision}, #{to}, #{toPrecision}, confidence, id, attested_from, CASE WHEN #{toPrecision}::text = 'unknown' THEN COALESCE(attested_to, now()) END, from_statement_id, implied, CASE WHEN start_marked AND end_marked THEN 'both' WHEN start_marked THEN 'start' WHEN end_marked THEN 'end' END FROM (SELECT f.*, c.start_changed OR COALESCE(f.corrected_ends IN ('start', 'both'), false) AS start_marked, c.end_changed OR f.end_derived OR COALESCE(f.corrected_ends IN ('end', 'both'), false) AS end_marked FROM facts f, LATERAL (SELECT f.valid_from IS DISTINCT FROM #{from}::timestamptz OR f.valid_from_precision IS DISTINCT FROM #{fromPrecision}::text AS start_changed, f.valid_to IS DISTINCT FROM #{to}::timestamptz OR f.valid_to_precision IS DISTINCT FROM #{toPrecision}::text AS end_changed) c WHERE f.id = #{factId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL) old RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_conflicts (id, kb_id, old_fact_id, new_fact_id, reason) SELECT #{id}, #{kbId}, #{oldFactId}, #{newFactId}, #{reason} WHERE NOT EXISTS ( WITH RECURSIVE a(id) AS ( SELECT #{oldFactId}::uuid UNION SELECT f.supersedes FROM facts f JOIN a ON f.id = a.id WHERE f.supersedes IS NOT NULL), b(id) AS ( SELECT #{newFactId}::uuid UNION SELECT f.supersedes FROM facts f JOIN b ON f.id = b.id WHERE f.supersedes IS NOT NULL) SELECT 1 FROM fact_conflicts c WHERE c.status = 'resolved' AND c.resolution = 'kept_both' AND ((c.old_fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM a) AND c.new_fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM b)) OR (c.old_fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM b) AND c.new_fact_id IN (SELECT id FROM a)))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_conflicts r WHERE r.old_fact_id = #{newFactId} AND r.new_fact_id = #{oldFactId} AND r.status = 'open') ON CONFLICT (old_fact_id, new_fact_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT c.old_fact_id, c.new_fact_id, fn_.valid_from, fn_.valid_from_precision FROM fact_conflicts c JOIN facts fn_ ON fn_.id = c.new_fact_id WHERE c.id = #{conflictId} AND c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.status = 'open'
mapper.update: UPDATE fact_conflicts SET status = 'resolved', resolution = #{resolution}, resolved_at = now() WHERE id = #{conflictId} AND kb_id = #{kbId}

WITH open AS ( SELECT f.id, f.predicate_id, f.subject_id AS holder, f.object_id, f.object_value, COALESCE(f.object_id::text, f.object_value::text) AS value_key, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_grade, f.confidence, f.recorded_at FROM facts f JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND r.temporal = 'state'
AND NOT (r.builtin AND r.key = 'known_as') AND (f.object_id IS NOT NULL OR f.object_value IS NOT NULL) ), crowded AS ( SELECT predicate_id, holder FROM open GROUP BY predicate_id, holder HAVING count(DISTINCT value_key) >= 2 ) SELECT o.id, o.predicate_id, r.key, r.label, r.kind, r.functional AS declared, h.canonical_name AS holder_name, e.canonical_name AS other_name, o.object_value, o.valid_from, o.valid_from_grade, o.confidence FROM open o JOIN crowded c ON c.predicate_id = o.predicate_id AND c.holder = o.holder JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = o.predicate_id JOIN entities h ON h.id = o.holder LEFT JOIN entities e ON e.id = o.object_id ORDER BY r.key, h.canonical_name, o.valid_from ASC NULLS LAST, o.recorded_at ASC

WITH open AS ( SELECT f.id, f.predicate_id, f.object_id AS holder, f.subject_id, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_grade, f.confidence, f.recorded_at FROM facts f JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.valid_to IS NULL AND f.valid_to_precision IS NULL AND r.temporal = 'state' AND r.kind = 'relation' AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL ), crowded AS ( SELECT predicate_id, holder FROM open GROUP BY predicate_id, holder HAVING count(DISTINCT subject_id) >= 2 ) SELECT o.id, o.predicate_id, r.key, r.label, r.kind, r.inverse_functional AS declared, h.canonical_name AS holder_name, e.canonical_name AS other_name, NULL::jsonb AS object_value, o.valid_from, o.valid_from_grade, o.confidence FROM open o JOIN crowded c ON c.predicate_id = o.predicate_id AND c.holder = o.holder JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = o.predicate_id JOIN entities h ON h.id = o.holder JOIN entities e ON e.id = o.subject_id ORDER BY r.key, h.canonical_name, o.valid_from ASC NULLS LAST, o.recorded_at ASC

SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS predicate_id, r.label, r.functional, r.inverse_functional, r.temporal FROM facts x JOIN facts y ON y.predicate_id = x.predicate_id AND y.kb_id = x.kb_id JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = x.predicate_id WHERE x.kb_id = #{kbId} AND x.invalidated_at IS NULL AND y.invalidated_at IS NULL AND x.object_id IS NOT NULL AND y.object_id IS NOT NULL AND ((r.functional AND x.subject_id = #{a} AND y.subject_id = #{b} AND x.object_id <> y.object_id) OR (r.inverse_functional AND x.object_id = #{a} AND y.object_id = #{b} AND x.subject_id <> y.subject_id))

SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.object_id, f.object_value, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, f.attested_to, f.end_derived, f.attested_from AS dated_at, f.valid_from_grade, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = ts.statement_id JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE ts.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described')) AS described FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.subject_id = ANY(#{holders,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AND f.predicate_id = #{predicateId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT f.id, f.subject_id, f.object_id, f.object_value, f.valid_from, f.valid_from_precision, f.valid_to, f.valid_to_precision, f.attested_to, f.end_derived, f.attested_from AS dated_at, f.valid_from_grade, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE fe.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN fact_evidence fe ON fe.fact_id = ts.statement_id JOIN chunks ch ON ch.id = fe.chunk_id WHERE ts.fact_id = f.id AND ch.origin = 'described')) AS described FROM facts f WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.object_id = ANY(#{holders,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AND f.predicate_id = #{predicateId} AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.object_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE facts f SET attested_from = w.at, attested_by = w.by FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (fe.fact_id) fe.fact_id, COALESCE(fe.attested_at, own.at) AS at, CASE WHEN fe.attested_at IS NOT NULL THEN fe.attested_by END AS by FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN documents d ON d.id = fe.document_id LEFT JOIN document_versions v ON v.document_id = fe.document_id AND v.version = fe.doc_version CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN d.doc_time_source IN ('content', 'source') THEN COALESCE(v.doc_time, d.doc_time) END AS at) own WHERE fe.fact_id = ANY(#{factIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY fe.fact_id, COALESCE(fe.attested_at, own.at) NULLS LAST, fe.chunk_id) w WHERE f.id = w.fact_id AND f.layer = 'open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (f.attested_from IS DISTINCT FROM w.at OR f.attested_by IS DISTINCT FROM w.by)

UPDATE facts t SET attested_from = src.at, attested_by = src.by FROM (SELECT u.fact_id, min(s.attested_from) AS at, (array_agg(s.attested_by ORDER BY s.attested_from NULLS LAST, s.id))[1] AS by FROM (SELECT ts.fact_id, ts.statement_id FROM typed_fact_sources ts JOIN facts k ON k.id = ts.statement_id AND k.kb_id = #{kbId} UNION ALL
SELECT i.fact_id, i.statement_id FROM implied_fact_sources i JOIN implication_rules r ON r.id = i.rule_id AND r.kb_id = #{kbId}) u LEFT JOIN facts s ON s.id = u.statement_id AND s.invalidated_at IS NULL GROUP BY u.fact_id) src WHERE t.id = src.fact_id AND t.kb_id = #{kbId} AND t.layer = 'typed' AND t.invalidated_at IS NULL AND (#{only,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[] IS NULL OR t.id = ANY(#{only,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[])) AND (t.implied OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts WHERE ts.fact_id = t.id)) AND (t.attested_from IS DISTINCT FROM src.at OR t.attested_by IS DISTINCT FROM src.by) RETURNING t.id
mapper.update: UPDATE facts f SET attested_from = e.first FROM (SELECT fe.fact_id, min(d.doc_time) AS first FROM fact_evidence fe JOIN chunks c ON c.id = fe.chunk_id JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE fe.fact_id = ANY(#{factIds,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.UuidArrayTypeHandler}::uuid[]) AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.doc_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fe.fact_id) e WHERE f.id = e.fact_id AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.layer <> 'open' AND NOT (f.implied OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM typed_fact_sources ts WHERE ts.fact_id = f.id)) AND f.attested_from IS DISTINCT FROM e.first
